measurement_basis: One authenticated Control claim-path rejection, retained in the Control campaign evidence record; recurrence is not established.

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment claims through the authenticated Control RPC

request.path_basis: Environment-reported absolute host checkout path inside the configured Projects workspace

outcome.observed_limitation: Control rejected the host checkout path during project-sandbox translation before the Environment claim authority evaluated the requested registered checkout.
outcome.diagnostic: client path escapes its scoped sandbox root
outcome.actionable_opportunity: Map an in-workspace host checkout path through the existing /workspace model for worktree claims, then preserve project grant, containment, symlink, registered-checkout, and claim ownership checks.
outcome.interpretation_limit: This was one path-interface failure. It does not establish a general claim-policy defect or justify bypassing a live overlapping owner.

related_work.campaign_objective: Implement MNCS environmental capability intelligence: connect authentic agent-session, diagnostics, resource, and compiler evidence to provenance-aware queryable projections that reveal actionable recurring environmental pressures, then verify and improve the observation-to-action loop.
related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket

pressure_hypothesis.title: Environment-reported host checkout paths were rejected before claim evaluation
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: Control project-sandbox path translation for Environment worktree claims
pressure_hypothesis.basis: A single authenticated claim attempt with an absolute checkout path reported by Environment failed in Control path translation. The corresponding /workspace path reached the separate claim-ownership decision. The evidence identifies an adapter mismatch, not a need to weaken ownership policy.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Accept an absolute host path only when it maps inside the configured workspace and the request already has project-scoped worktree authority; then run the existing checkout and ownership checks.
